facts.fact: KRAY 乘印度航空飞回瓦拉纳西，目的是取回 KANDINSKY 织的那件毛衣。
facts.anchor: KRAY flew Air India back to Varanasi in hopes of recovering KAN-DINSKY’s sweater.

facts.fact: 飞机临近降落时，男女乘务员拿着喷雾罐冲过客舱，给全体乘客喷药。
facts.anchor: the steward and stewardess stormed through the cabin with aerosol cans and sprayed everybody down

facts.fact: 另有一些印度家庭在飞机仍高于地面一千英尺时解开安全带、起身打开头顶行李舱、挤到前舱门排队。
facts.anchor: several Indian families unbuckled their seatbelts, stood up, popped open their overhead compartments

facts.fact: 飞行员猛摇机翼、广播响起 TERRAIN 告警后，KRAY 心率升到每分钟一百六十次，但他没有叫出声。
facts.anchor: KRAY’s heart rate shot up to 160 beats per minute, but at least he didn’t scream.

facts.fact: 在机场外，KRAY 瞥见同机的那个尼泊尔男人一边打手机一边快步走开，随后钻进一辆白色面包车。
facts.anchor: he caught the Nepali guy from his flight hustling too while talking into a cell phone

facts.fact: 客栈前台起初不肯让 KRAY 回房，随着讨价还价把价钱越抬越高，最后收下一笔大额贿赂才松口。
facts.anchor: The clerk dug in his heels as he dickered higher and higher.

facts.fact: 两人进房后看见一个体形极大的印度男人在床上熟睡并大声打鼾。
facts.anchor: There they found an exceedingly large Indian man fast asleep in the middle of the bed, snoring loudly.

facts.fact: 那个男人收下一百美元后改口，说姐姐给他的毛衣百分之百归 KRAY 所有。
facts.anchor: Jumper my sister gave to me only is hundred percent yours only

facts.fact: KRAY 抢回毛衣后赶回机场，订到两小时后起飞、飞往曼谷的航班。
facts.anchor: where he managed to get booked onto a flight to Bangkok that left two hours later
